description: This file implements SCIM v2 endpoints for managing users and groups within the LiteLLM proxy system. It handles CRUD operations for users and groups, including patching, creation, retrieval, and deletion, following the SCIM v2 protocol. The code integrates with FastAPI, Prisma for database access, and performs user provisioning, role management, and group membership synchronization, with support for enterprise features and internal user management.
